cases.case_label: Founder SVA_F in TAF1 intron 32 (XDP) - female carrier iPSCs, TAF1-32i
cases.mechanism_detail: The XDP SVA in TAF1 intron 32 is associated with a mutant isoform retaining intron 32 (TAF1-32i), detected in XDP male iPSCs and in female carrier iPSCs that express the mutant X; the paper also cites reduced canonical TAF1 expression in XDP cells.
cases.quote: As expected, we detected TAF1-32i in XDP male iPSCs.
